//go:build windows

package windows

import (
	"bytes"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/binary"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"slices"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"testing"

	"github.com/codetreker/remote-fs/packages/smb/internal/wire"
	"github.com/codetreker/remote-fs/packages/storage"
)

const earlyWireMaxRecords = 128
const earlyWireMaxPending = 64
const earlyWireMaxBytes = 64 << 10
const earlyWireMaxNameBytes = 1024

type earlyWireRecord struct {
	Sequence                                 uint64
	Connection, RawSession, Session, Message uint64
	RawTree                                  *uint32
	Tree                                     uint32
	AsyncID                                  *uint64
	Related                                  bool
	RelatedCreate                            uint64
	Command                                  uint16
	Response                                 bool
	Status                                   uint32
	Name, FileID                             string
	RawFileID                                string
	Predecessor                              *parentNotifyKey
	OwnerPending                             bool
	QueryType, QueryClass                    byte
	Attributes                               *preciseFilesystemAttributes
	Complete                                 bool
	Error                                    string
}

type earlyWirePending struct {
	record  earlyWireRecord
	async   *uint64
	pending bool
}
type earlyWireChainKey struct {
	connection uint64
	response   bool
}
type earlyWireChain struct {
	previous parentNotifyKey
	active   bool
}
type earlyIdentityEvent struct {
	packet   []byte
	wire     cacheGatePositiveWireRecord
	sequence uint64
}

type earlyMarkers struct{ Started, Settled, HABegin, Mutation, FirstNewBegin, FirstNewEnd uint64 }

type earlyBootstrapState struct {
	UNC     string
	Volume  storage.FileVolumeState
	Markers earlyMarkers
	Process *earlyBootstrapProcessReceipt
	Error   string
}

var earlyRegistry struct {
	sync.Mutex
	records  []earlyWireRecord
	pending  map[parentNotifyKey]earlyWirePending
	chains   map[earlyWireChainKey]earlyWireChain
	bytes    int
	failure  error
	state    earlyBootstrapState
	identity []earlyIdentityEvent
	active   bool
}

func earlyReset() {
	earlyRegistry.Lock()
	defer earlyRegistry.Unlock()
	earlyRegistry.records = nil
	earlyRegistry.pending = make(map[parentNotifyKey]earlyWirePending)
	earlyRegistry.chains = make(map[earlyWireChainKey]earlyWireChain)
	earlyRegistry.bytes = 0
	earlyRegistry.failure = nil
	earlyRegistry.state = earlyBootstrapState{}
	earlyRegistry.identity = nil
	earlyRegistry.active = false
}

func earlyActivate()   { earlyRegistry.Lock(); earlyRegistry.active = true; earlyRegistry.Unlock() }
func earlyDeactivate() { earlyRegistry.Lock(); earlyRegistry.active = false; earlyRegistry.Unlock() }
func earlyRelatedActive(flags uint32) bool {
	earlyRegistry.Lock()
	defer earlyRegistry.Unlock()
	return earlyRegistry.active && flags&wire.FlagRelated != 0
}

func earlySnapshot() ([]earlyWireRecord, error) {
	earlyRegistry.Lock()
	defer earlyRegistry.Unlock()
	err := earlyRegistry.failure
	for _, record := range earlyRegistry.records {
		if record.OwnerPending {
			err = errors.Join(err, errors.New("related ownership awaits a validated predecessor result"))
			break
		}
	}
	if len(earlyRegistry.identity) != 0 {
		err = errors.Join(err, errors.New("identity observations await related ownership"))
	}
	return slices.Clone(earlyRegistry.records), err
}

func earlySelected(command uint16) bool {
	switch command {
	case wire.SessionSetup, wire.TreeConnect, wire.TreeDisconnect, wire.Logoff, wire.Create, wire.Close, wire.Read, wire.QueryDirectory, wire.QueryInfo, wire.ChangeNotify:
		return true
	}
	return false
}

func earlyTreeCommand(command uint16) bool {
	return earlySelected(command) && command != wire.SessionSetup && command != wire.Logoff && command != wire.TreeConnect
}

func earlyRecordCost(record earlyWireRecord) int {
	charge := 512 + 4*(len(record.Name)+len(record.FileID)+len(record.RawFileID)+len(record.Error))
	if record.Attributes != nil {
		charge += 4 * (len(record.Attributes.FixedRaw) + len(record.Attributes.NameRaw) + len(record.Attributes.Name))
	}
	return charge
}

func earlyRecordLocked(record earlyWireRecord, err error) bool {
	if earlyRegistry.failure != nil {
		return false
	}
	if err != nil {
		record.Error = err.Error()
		record.Complete = false
		earlyRegistry.failure = err
	}
	cost := earlyRecordCost(record)
	if len(earlyRegistry.records) >= earlyWireMaxRecords || cost > earlyWireMaxBytes-earlyRegistry.bytes {
		earlyRegistry.failure = errors.New("early tree evidence retention bound exceeded")
		return false
	}
	earlyRegistry.bytes += cost
	earlyRegistry.records = append(earlyRegistry.records, record)
	return err == nil
}

func earlyFindLocked(key parentNotifyKey, response bool) *earlyWireRecord {
	for i := range earlyRegistry.records {
		record := &earlyRegistry.records[i]
		if record.Connection == key.Connection && record.Message == key.MessageID && record.Response == response && (!response || record.Status != 0x103) {
			return record
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func earlyNeedsFile(command uint16) bool {
	switch command {
	case wire.Close, wire.Read, wire.QueryDirectory, wire.QueryInfo, wire.ChangeNotify:
		return true
	}
	return false
}

// RELATED request IDs come from the preceding operation/result; their raw
// header/body values are ignored even when they are not all-ones sentinels.
// https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/openspecs/windows_protocols/ms-smb2/46dd4182-62d3-4e30-9fe5-e2ec124edca1
func earlyResolveOwnersLocked() error {
	for round := 0; round < len(earlyRegistry.records); round++ {
		changed := false
		for i := range earlyRegistry.records {
			record := &earlyRegistry.records[i]
			if !record.OwnerPending {
				continue
			}
			if !record.Response {
				if record.Predecessor == nil {
					return errors.New("related request has no predecessor")
				}
				prior := earlyFindLocked(*record.Predecessor, true)
				if prior == nil || prior.OwnerPending {
					continue
				}
				if prior.Status != 0 {
					return errors.New("related predecessor failed; ownership is not established")
				}
				record.Session = prior.Session
				record.Tree = prior.Tree
				if earlyNeedsFile(record.Command) {
					if prior.FileID == "" {
						return errors.New("related predecessor did not contain or produce a file handle")
					}
					record.FileID = prior.FileID
					record.RelatedCreate = prior.RelatedCreate
					if prior.Command == wire.Create {
						record.RelatedCreate = prior.Message
					}
				}
				if record.Command != wire.SessionSetup && record.Session == 0 || earlyTreeCommand(record.Command) && record.Tree == 0 {
					return errors.New("related predecessor did not allocate required session/tree")
				}
				record.OwnerPending = false
				changed = true
			} else {
				request := earlyFindLocked(parentNotifyKey{record.Connection, record.Message}, false)
				if request == nil {
					return errors.New("response has no recorded request")
				}
				if request.OwnerPending {
					continue
				}
				if err := earlyResponseOwner(record, request); err != nil {
					return err
				}
				record.OwnerPending = false
				changed = true
			}
		}
		if !changed {
			break
		}
	}
	// Pending map entries own the same effective request observation. Raw bytes
	// remain available on the immutable raw fields in the recorded request.
	for key, pending := range earlyRegistry.pending {
		if request := earlyFindLocked(key, false); request != nil {
			pending.record = *request
			earlyRegistry.pending[key] = pending
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func earlyResponseOwner(record, request *earlyWireRecord) error {
	record.Predecessor = request.Predecessor
	record.RelatedCreate = request.RelatedCreate
	record.Name = request.Name
	record.FileID = request.FileID
	if record.Command == wire.SessionSetup && request.Session == 0 {
		if (record.Status == 0 || record.Status == 0xc0000016) && record.RawSession == 0 {
			return errors.New("initial SESSION_SETUP did not allocate a session")
		}
	} else if record.RawSession != request.Session {
		return errors.New("early response changed its resolved session")
	}

	record.Session = record.RawSession
	if record.AsyncID != nil {
		record.Tree = request.Tree
	} else {
		if record.RawTree == nil {
			return errors.New("synchronous response has no physical tree field")
		}
		record.Tree = *record.RawTree
		if record.Command != wire.TreeConnect && earlyTreeCommand(record.Command) && record.Tree != request.Tree {
			return errors.New("early response changed its resolved tree")
		}
	}
	if record.Command == wire.Create {
		record.FileID = ""
		if record.Status == 0 {
			record.FileID = record.RawFileID
			if record.FileID == "" {
				return errors.New("successful CREATE did not produce a physical handle")
			}
		}
	}
	return nil
}

// The existing frame parser validates command bodies first. Effective ownership
// may remain pending until an earlier operation's real response is observed.
func earlyCapture(packet []byte, r cacheGatePositiveWireRecord) bool {
	h, err := wire.ParseHeader(packet)
	if err != nil {
		earlyRegistry.Lock()
		earlyRegistry.failure = errors.Join(earlyRegistry.failure, err)
		earlyRegistry.Unlock()
		return false
	}
	sequence := parentObservationBoundary()
	earlyRegistry.Lock()
	defer earlyRegistry.Unlock()
	selected := earlySelected(h.Command)
	record := earlyWireRecord{Sequence: sequence, Connection: r.Connection, RawSession: h.SessionID, Session: h.SessionID, Message: h.MessageID, Command: h.Command, Response: h.Flags&wire.FlagResponse != 0, Status: h.Status, Related: h.Flags&wire.FlagRelated != 0, QueryType: r.QueryType, QueryClass: r.QueryClass}
	if h.Flags&wire.FlagAsync != 0 {
		v := h.AsyncID
		record.AsyncID = &v
	} else {
		v := h.TreeID
		record.RawTree = &v
		record.Tree = v
	}
	if len(packet) > cacheGatePositiveMaxFrame || len(packet) < 72 || r.Connection == 0 || h.Command != r.Command || h.MessageID != r.MessageID || record.Response != r.Response || h.Status != r.Status || h.SessionID != r.SessionID || r.Incomplete != "" {
		err = errors.New("early header and correlated record disagree")
	}
	key := parentNotifyKey{record.Connection, record.Message}
	chainKey := earlyWireChainKey{record.Connection, false}
	chain := earlyRegistry.chains[chainKey]
	if !record.Response {
		if record.Related {
			if !chain.active {
				err = errors.New("related tree member lacks a prior compound operation")
			} else {
				previous := chain.previous
				record.Predecessor = &previous
				record.OwnerPending = true
				record.Session = 0
				record.Tree = 0
			}
		} else if record.Session == ^uint64(0) || record.Tree == ^uint32(0) {
			err = errors.New("unrelated request uses inherited session/tree sentinels")
		}
		if h.NextCommand == 0 {
			delete(earlyRegistry.chains, chainKey)
		} else {
			if len(earlyRegistry.chains) >= 16 && !chain.active {
				err = errors.New("early compound chain bound exceeded")
			}
			earlyRegistry.chains[chainKey] = earlyWireChain{key, true}
		}
	}
	if selected && err == nil {
		if record.Response {
			pending, ok := earlyRegistry.pending[key]
			if !ok || pending.record.Command != record.Command {
				err = errors.New("early response lacks an exact request")
			} else {
				if record.Status == 0x103 {
					if record.AsyncID == nil || pending.pending {
						err = errors.New("pending response lacks unique asynchronous ownership")
					} else {
						pending.pending = true
						pending.async = record.AsyncID
						earlyRegistry.pending[key] = pending
					}
				} else {
					if record.AsyncID != nil && (!pending.pending || pending.async == nil || *pending.async != *record.AsyncID) {
						err = errors.New("async final lacks its owned pending AsyncId")
					}
					if record.AsyncID == nil && pending.pending {
						err = errors.New("async pending was completed by a synchronous response")
					}
					delete(earlyRegistry.pending, key)
				}
				if record.Command == wire.Create && record.Status == 0 {
					record.RawFileID = strings.Clone(r.FileID)
				}
				request := pending.record
				record.OwnerPending = request.OwnerPending
				if record.OwnerPending {
					record.Session = 0
					record.Tree = 0
					record.Name = request.Name
					record.Predecessor = request.Predecessor
				} else if ownerErr := earlyResponseOwner(&record, &request); ownerErr != nil {
					err = ownerErr
				}
			}
		} else {
			if record.AsyncID != nil {
				err = errors.New("selected asynchronous request has no supported tree ownership")
			}
			if len(r.Name) > earlyWireMaxNameBytes || len(r.FileID) > 64 {
				err = errors.New("early name or handle exceeds bound")
			} else {
				record.Name = strings.Clone(r.Name)
				record.RawFileID = strings.Clone(r.FileID)
				if !record.OwnerPending {
					record.FileID = record.RawFileID
				}
			}
			body := packet[wire.HeaderSize:]
			if record.Command == wire.TreeConnect {
				if !cacheGatePositiveFixed(body, 9, 8) {
					err = errors.New("TREE_CONNECT request is truncated")
				} else {
					length, offset := binary.LittleEndian.Uint16(body[6:8]), binary.LittleEndian.Uint16(body[4:6])
					if int(length) > earlyWireMaxNameBytes {
						err = errors.New("TREE_CONNECT path exceeds bound")
					} else {
						data, ok := cacheGatePositiveField(packet, uint32(offset), uint32(length), 72)
						if !ok {
							err = errors.New("TREE_CONNECT path span is invalid")
						} else {
							record.Name, err = wire.DecodeUTF16(data)
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if record.Command == wire.Close || record.Command == wire.QueryDirectory || record.Command == wire.ChangeNotify {
				minimum, size := 24, uint16(24)
				if record.Command == wire.QueryDirectory {
					minimum = 32
					size = 33
				}
				if record.Command == wire.ChangeNotify {
					minimum = 32
					size = 32
				}
				if !cacheGatePositiveFixed(body, size, minimum) {
					err = errors.New("early handle request is truncated")
				} else {
					record.RawFileID = hex.EncodeToString(body[8:24])
					if !record.OwnerPending {
						record.FileID = record.RawFileID
					}
				}
			}
			if earlyFindLocked(key, false) != nil {
				err = errors.New("early request MessageID was reused")
			}
			if len(earlyRegistry.pending) >= earlyWireMaxPending {
				err = errors.New("early pending request bound exceeded")
			}
			if err == nil {
				earlyRegistry.pending[key] = earlyWirePending{record: record}
			}
		}
		if err == nil && !record.OwnerPending && earlyTreeCommand(record.Command) && (record.Tree == 0 || record.Session == 0) {
			err = errors.New("early tree operation has no effective owner")
		}
		if err == nil && record.Response && record.Status == 0 && record.Command == wire.QueryInfo && record.QueryType == 2 && record.QueryClass == 5 {
			// This decoder reads the response payload; its correlation fields are
			// checked separately before pending ownership can become qualified.
			view := r
			if record.Session != 0 {
				view.SessionID = record.Session
			}
			identity, decodeErr := preciseIdentityFields(packet, view)
			err = decodeErr
			record.Attributes = identity.FilesystemAttributes
		}
	}
	if !selected {
		if err != nil {
			earlyRegistry.failure = err
			return false
		}
		return true
	}
	record.Complete = err == nil
	if !earlyRecordLocked(record, err) {
		return false
	}
	if err := earlyResolveOwnersLocked(); err != nil {
		earlyRegistry.failure = err
		return false
	}
	return true
}

func earlyRequest(observer *cacheGatePositiveFrameObserver, packet []byte, r *cacheGatePositiveWireRecord) bool {
	earlyRegistry.Lock()
	active := earlyRegistry.active
	earlyRegistry.Unlock()
	if !active {
		return true
	}
	return earlyCapture(packet, *r)
}

func earlyObservedLocked(r cacheGatePositiveWireRecord) *earlyWireRecord {
	for i := len(earlyRegistry.records) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
		record := &earlyRegistry.records[i]
		if record.Connection == r.Connection && record.Message == r.MessageID && record.Response == r.Response && record.Status == r.Status && record.Command == r.Command {
			return record
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func earlyCorrelatedView(record *earlyWireRecord, r cacheGatePositiveWireRecord) cacheGatePositiveWireRecord {
	r.SessionID = record.Session
	r.FileID = record.FileID
	// The effective FileID is proven by the predecessor result. The legacy
	// observer can use direct ownership while the raw linkage remains here.
	r.RelatedCreate = 0
	r.related = false
	return r
}

// The caller holds the current frame observer's mutex. Only its owned metadata
// copies change; packet bytes, raw header fields and original timestamps do not.
func earlyNormalizeLocked(observer *cacheGatePositiveFrameObserver, current *cacheGatePositiveWireRecord) {
	for _, record := range earlyRegistry.records {
		if record.Connection != observer.id || record.OwnerPending {
			continue
		}
		if !record.Response {
			key := parentNotifyKey{record.Connection, record.Message}
			if pending, ok := observer.pending[record.Message]; ok {
				observer.pending[record.Message] = earlyCorrelatedView(&record, pending)
			}
			if record.Command == wire.ChangeNotify {
				parentNotifyRegistry.Lock()
				if request, ok := parentNotifyRegistry.requests[key]; ok {
					request.Session = record.Session
					request.FileID = record.FileID
					parentNotifyRegistry.requests[key] = request
				}
				parentNotifyRegistry.Unlock()
			}
		}
		for i := range observer.records {
			observed := &observer.records[i]
			if observed.Connection == record.Connection && observed.MessageID == record.Message && observed.Response == record.Response && observed.Status == record.Status && observed.Command == record.Command {
				*observed = earlyCorrelatedView(&record, *observed)
			}
		}
	}
	if record := earlyObservedLocked(*current); record != nil && !record.OwnerPending {
		*current = earlyCorrelatedView(record, *current)
	}
}

func earlyComplete(observer *cacheGatePositiveFrameObserver, packet []byte, r *cacheGatePositiveWireRecord) bool {
	earlyRegistry.Lock()
	active := earlyRegistry.active
	earlyRegistry.Unlock()
	if !active {
		return cacheGatePreciseIdentity(packet, *r)
	}
	if r.Response && !earlyCapture(packet, *r) {
		return false
	}
	earlyRegistry.Lock()
	defer earlyRegistry.Unlock()
	if earlyRegistry.failure != nil {
		return false
	}
	record := earlyObservedLocked(*r)
	if record == nil {
		return true
	}
	earlyNormalizeLocked(observer, r)
	selected := preciseIdentitySelected(*r) || r.Command == wire.QueryInfo && r.QueryType == 2 && r.QueryClass == 5
	// Interim responses contain no completed identity value. Their owned AsyncId
	// and effective tree remain in the raw early trace until the terminal result.
	if selected && !(r.Response && r.Status == 0x103) {
		cost := 128 + len(packet)
		if len(earlyRegistry.identity) >= earlyWireMaxPending || cost > earlyWireMaxBytes-earlyRegistry.bytes {
			earlyRegistry.failure = errors.New("deferred identity evidence exceeds existing byte bound")
			return false
		}
		earlyRegistry.bytes += cost
		earlyRegistry.identity = append(earlyRegistry.identity, earlyIdentityEvent{packet: bytes.Clone(packet), wire: *r, sequence: record.Sequence})
	}
	for len(earlyRegistry.identity) > 0 {
		event := earlyRegistry.identity[0]
		var observed *earlyWireRecord
		for i := range earlyRegistry.records {
			if earlyRegistry.records[i].Sequence == event.sequence {
				observed = &earlyRegistry.records[i]
				break
			}
		}
		if observed == nil {
			earlyRegistry.failure = errors.New("deferred identity observation lost its source record")
			return false
		}
		if observed.OwnerPending {
			break
		}
		view := earlyCorrelatedView(observed, event.wire)
		preciseIdentityRegistry.Lock()
		before := len(preciseIdentityRegistry.records)
		preciseIdentityRegistry.Unlock()
		accepted := cacheGatePreciseIdentity(event.packet, view)
		preciseIdentityRegistry.Lock()
		if len(preciseIdentityRegistry.records) > before {
			last := &preciseIdentityRegistry.records[len(preciseIdentityRegistry.records)-1]
			last.RawSession = observed.RawSession
			last.Sequence = observed.Sequence
			key := parentNotifyKey{view.Connection, view.MessageID}
			if pending, ok := preciseIdentityRegistry.pending[key]; ok {
				pending.RawSession = observed.RawSession
				pending.Sequence = observed.Sequence
				preciseIdentityRegistry.pending[key] = pending
			}
		}
		preciseIdentityRegistry.Unlock()
		earlyRegistry.bytes -= 128 + len(event.packet)
		earlyRegistry.identity[0] = earlyIdentityEvent{}
		earlyRegistry.identity = earlyRegistry.identity[1:]
		if !accepted {
			earlyRegistry.failure = errors.New("identity observer rejected the resolved correlation")
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

type earlyWireEvidence struct {
	Outcome, Reason                                          string
	Exposed, NoWarming, WatcherPending, HAProven, HnewProven bool
	HnewBound                                                bool
	Connection, Session                                      uint64
	Tree                                                     uint32
	Share, VolumeIdentity                                    string
	VolumeSerial                                             uint64
	Markers                                                  earlyMarkers
	TreeConnect, RootCreate, Fs5, HA, Hnew                   *earlyWireRecord
}

type earlyHandleKey struct {
	connection, session uint64
	tree                uint32
	file                string
}

func earlyWireGate(records []earlyWireRecord, identities []preciseIdentityRecord, unc string, volume storage.FileVolumeState, markers earlyMarkers, watcher *parentNotifyRequest, final bool) earlyWireEvidence {
	result := earlyWireEvidence{Outcome: "inconclusive", Share: unc, VolumeIdentity: volume.VolumeIdentity, Markers: markers}
	reject := func(reason string) earlyWireEvidence { result.Exposed = false; result.Reason = reason; return result }
	if volume.VolumeIdentity == "" || volume.RootID == 0 || volume.MaxEventBytes <= 0 || !strings.HasPrefix(unc, `\\127.0.0.1\`) || strings.Count(unc, `\`) != 3 {
		return reject("authoritative share/volume anchor is absent")
	}
	sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(volume.VolumeIdentity))
	result.VolumeSerial = binary.LittleEndian.Uint64(sum[:8])
	if markers.Started == 0 || markers.Settled <= markers.Started || markers.HABegin <= markers.Settled {
		return reject("bootstrap exit and HA admission source order is absent")
	}
	if watcher == nil || watcher.Key.Connection == 0 || watcher.Session == 0 || watcher.FileID == "" || watcher.Filter != parentNotifyFilter || !watcher.Recursive {
		return reject("original recursive watcher ownership is absent")
	}
	type exchange struct{ request, response *earlyWireRecord }
	exchanges := make(map[parentNotifyKey]exchange)
	handles := make(map[earlyHandleKey]*earlyWireRecord)
	var previous uint64
	for i := range records {
		record := &records[i]
		if !record.Complete || record.Error != "" || record.OwnerPending || record.Sequence <= previous {
			return reject("early passive source is incomplete or unordered")
		}
		previous = record.Sequence
		key := parentNotifyKey{record.Connection, record.Message}
		pair := exchanges[key]
		if !record.Response {
			if pair.request != nil {
				return reject("early request identity was reused")
			}
			pair.request = record
		} else {
			if pair.request == nil || pair.request.Command != record.Command || pair.response != nil {
				return reject("early response ownership is incomplete")
			}
			if record.Status != 0x103 {
				pair.response = record
			}
		}
		exchanges[key] = pair
		if record.Response && record.Command == wire.Create && record.Status == 0 {
			if record.FileID == "" {
				return reject("successful early CREATE has no handle")
			}
			handle := earlyHandleKey{record.Connection, record.Session, record.Tree, record.FileID}
			if _, exists := handles[handle]; exists {
				return reject("early CREATE reused a server handle")
			}
			handles[handle] = record
		}
	}
	// A unique successful TREE_CONNECT binds this experiment's exact share.
	for _, pair := range exchanges {
		if pair.request.Command != wire.TreeConnect || pair.request.Name != unc || pair.response == nil || pair.response.Status != 0 {
			continue
		}
		if result.TreeConnect != nil {
			return reject("experimental share has ambiguous TREE_CONNECT ownership")
		}
		response := pair.response
		if response.Tree == 0 || response.Session == 0 || response.Session != pair.request.Session || response.Connection != watcher.Key.Connection || response.Session != watcher.Session {
			return reject("experimental share changed native session ownership")
		}
		result.TreeConnect = response
		result.Connection = response.Connection
		result.Session = response.Session
		result.Tree = response.Tree
	}
	if result.TreeConnect == nil {
		return reject("experimental share was not observed in TREE_CONNECT")
	}
	sameTree := func(record *earlyWireRecord) bool {
		return record.Connection == result.Connection && record.Session == result.Session && record.Tree == result.Tree
	}
	known := func(record *earlyWireRecord) *earlyWireRecord {
		if record.RelatedCreate != 0 {
			pair := exchanges[parentNotifyKey{record.Connection, record.RelatedCreate}]
			if pair.request == nil || pair.response == nil || pair.request.Command != wire.Create || pair.response.Status != 0 || pair.request.Sequence >= record.Sequence || pair.response.Session != record.Session || pair.response.Tree != record.Tree {
				return nil
			}
			return pair.response
		}
		return handles[earlyHandleKey{record.Connection, record.Session, record.Tree, record.FileID}]
	}
	watchPair := exchanges[watcher.Key]
	if watchPair.request == nil || watchPair.request.Command != wire.ChangeNotify || watchPair.request.FileID != watcher.FileID || !sameTree(watchPair.request) {
		return reject("watcher is not owned by the experimental tree")
	}
	watchRoot := known(watchPair.request)
	if watchRoot == nil || watchRoot.Name != "" || watchRoot.Sequence >= watchPair.request.Sequence {
		return reject("watcher has no observed ancestor root CREATE")
	}
	var pending *earlyWireRecord
	for i := range records {
		record := &records[i]
		if record.Command == wire.ChangeNotify && record.Response && record.Connection == watcher.Key.Connection && record.Message == watcher.Key.MessageID {
			if record.Status == 0x103 {
				if pending != nil {
					return reject("watcher has duplicate pending responses")
				}
				pending = record
			} else if record.Sequence < markers.HABegin {
				return reject("watcher retired before HA admission")
			}
		}
	}
	if pending == nil || pending.Sequence >= markers.Started || !sameTree(pending) {
		return reject("watcher was not actually pending before bootstrap")
	}
	result.WatcherPending = true
	retirementEnd := markers.HABegin
	if final {
		if markers.Mutation <= markers.HABegin || markers.FirstNewBegin <= markers.Mutation || markers.FirstNewEnd <= markers.FirstNewBegin {
			return reject("later mutation and first-new-open source boundaries are missing")
		}
		retirementEnd = markers.FirstNewEnd
	}
	for i := range records {
		record := &records[i]
		if record.Sequence < retirementEnd && record.Connection == result.Connection && (record.Command == wire.Logoff && record.Session == result.Session || record.Command == wire.TreeDisconnect && sameTree(record)) {
			return reject("the experimental session or tree retired before native admission")
		}
		if !record.Response && record.Command == wire.Close && record.Sequence < markers.HABegin && sameTree(record) && record.FileID == watcher.FileID {
			return reject("bootstrap closed the parent's watcher handle")
		}
		if record.Sequence >= markers.HABegin {
			continue
		}
		if record.Command == wire.Create && !record.Response && record.Name != "" && record.Name != "v" {
			return reject("native target CREATE preceded the HA API marker")
		}
		if record.Command == wire.QueryDirectory || record.Command == wire.Read {
			return reject("enumeration or read traffic warmed targets before HA")
		}
		if record.Command == wire.QueryInfo {
			target := known(record)
			if target == nil || (record.RelatedCreate == 0 || record.Response) && target.Sequence >= record.Sequence || target.Name != "" && target.Name != "v" {
				return reject("unknown or target metadata traffic preceded HA")
			}
		}
	}
	result.NoWarming = true
	for i := range records {
		response := &records[i]
		if !response.Response || response.Command != wire.QueryInfo || response.QueryType != 2 || response.QueryClass != 5 || response.Sequence <= markers.Started || response.Sequence >= markers.Settled {
			continue
		}
		if response.Status != 0 {
			return reject("bootstrap filesystem query failed on the wire")
		}
		request := exchanges[parentNotifyKey{response.Connection, response.Message}].request
		if request == nil || request.Sequence <= markers.Started || !sameTree(response) || !sameTree(request) {
			return reject("bootstrap filesystem query crossed tree or invocation ownership")
		}
		root := known(response)
		if root == nil || root.Name != "" || root.Sequence >= response.Sequence || request.RelatedCreate == 0 && root.Sequence >= request.Sequence {
			return reject("bootstrap Fs5 is not bound to a proven root open")
		}
		if result.Fs5 != nil {
			return reject("bootstrap contains ambiguous root filesystem queries")
		}
		attributes := response.Attributes
		if attributes == nil || len(attributes.FixedRaw) != 24 || len(attributes.NameRaw) > preciseFilesystemNameBytes*2 {
			return reject("bootstrap Fs5 lacks bounded raw fields")
		}
		raw, err := hex.DecodeString(attributes.FixedRaw + attributes.NameRaw)
		if err != nil {
			return reject("bootstrap Fs5 raw fields are malformed")
		}
		decoded, err := preciseDecodeFilesystemAttributes(raw)
		if err != nil || *decoded != *attributes || attributes.Flags != 0x406 || attributes.MaximumComponent != 255 || attributes.Name != "remote-fs" {
			return reject("bootstrap Fs5 is not the truthful configured capability tuple")
		}
		result.Fs5 = response
		result.RootCreate = root
	}
	if result.Fs5 == nil {
		return reject("no actual root Fs5 response was observed during the helper invocation")
	}
	if final {
		for i := range records {
			response := &records[i]
			if !response.Response || response.Command != wire.Create || response.Name != `v\target` {
				continue
			}
			request := exchanges[parentNotifyKey{response.Connection, response.Message}].request
			if request == nil || !sameTree(request) || !sameTree(response) {
				return reject("native target CREATE changed experimental tree ownership")
			}
			if response.Status == 0 && request.Sequence > markers.HABegin && request.Sequence < markers.Mutation {
				if result.HA == nil {
					result.HA = response
				}
			}
			if request.Sequence > markers.FirstNewBegin && request.Sequence < markers.FirstNewEnd {
				if result.Hnew != nil {
					return reject("first Hnew API has ambiguous target CREATE requests")
				}
				result.Hnew = response
			}
		}
		if result.HA == nil || result.HA.Sequence >= markers.Mutation {
			return reject("initial HA lacks a successful CREATE after its API marker")
		}
		if result.Hnew == nil {
			return reject("Hnew lacks an actual request/response on the original tree")
		}
		result.HnewBound = true
		if result.Hnew.Status == 0 {
			if result.Hnew.FileID == "" || result.Hnew.FileID == result.HA.FileID {
				return reject("successful Hnew lacks distinct server-open ownership")
			}
			result.HnewProven = true
		} else if result.Hnew.FileID != "" {
			return reject("failed Hnew acquired a successful server handle")
		}
		result.HAProven = true
	}
	for _, identity := range identities {
		if !identity.Complete || identity.Error != "" {
			return reject("selected identity payload evidence is incomplete")
		}
		if !identity.Response || identity.Command != wire.Create || identity.Status != 0 || identity.QFid == nil {
			continue
		}
		pair := exchanges[parentNotifyKey{identity.Connection, identity.MessageID}]
		if pair.response == nil || pair.response.Command != wire.Create || pair.response.FileID != identity.FileID || pair.response.Session != identity.Session || !sameTree(pair.response) {
			return reject("observed QFid lacks original-tree CREATE ownership")
		}
		if identity.QFid.VolumeID != result.VolumeSerial {
			return reject("actual QFid volume conflicts with the authoritative share binding")
		}
	}
	result.Exposed = true
	result.Outcome = "qualified_early_exposure"
	return result
}

func earlyRequestedOnly(records []preciseIdentityRecord) error {
	requests := make(map[parentNotifyKey]preciseIdentityRecord)
	for _, record := range records {
		if !record.Complete || record.Error != "" {
			return errors.New("early identity evidence is incomplete")
		}
		if record.Command != wire.Create {
			continue
		}
		key := parentNotifyKey{record.Connection, record.MessageID}
		if !record.Response {
			if _, exists := requests[key]; exists {
				return errors.New("early CREATE request was reused")
			}
			requests[key] = record
			continue
		}
		request, ok := requests[key]
		if !ok || request.Session != record.Session {
			return errors.New("early CREATE context lacks a request")
		}
		delete(requests, key)
		if record.Status == 0 && (!request.ContextsChecked || !record.ContextsChecked || request.QFidRequested != record.QFidRequested || (record.QFid != nil) != request.QFidRequested || preciseContextQFidCount(request) != map[bool]int{false: 0, true: 1}[request.QFidRequested] || preciseContextQFidCount(record) != map[bool]int{false: 0, true: 1}[request.QFidRequested]) {
			return errors.New("bootstrap fixture did not retain requested-only QFid")
		}
		if record.Status != 0 && record.QFid != nil {
			return errors.New("failed early CREATE acquired QFid")
		}
	}
	if len(requests) != 0 {
		return errors.New("early CREATE response is missing")
	}
	return nil
}

func earlyPending(records []earlyWireRecord, watcher *parentNotifyRequest) bool {
	if watcher == nil {
		return false
	}
	found := false
	for _, record := range records {
		if record.Response && record.Command == wire.ChangeNotify && record.Connection == watcher.Key.Connection && record.Message == watcher.Key.MessageID {
			if record.Status != 0x103 || found {
				return false
			}
			found = true
		}
	}
	return found
}

func earlyBootstrapBeforeHA(t *testing.T, bridge *nativeBridge, report *parentInvalidationReport, watch *parentNativeWatch) {
	t.Helper()
	if watch == nil || watch.done || report.Pending == nil {
		t.Fatal("early bootstrap requires the original live watcher")
	}
	state, err := bridge.remote.FileState(t.Context())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal("early authoritative volume anchor:", err)
	}
	if state.VolumeIdentity == "" || state.VolumeIdentity != bridge.backend.identity || state.RootID == 0 || state.MaxEventBytes <= 0 {
		t.Fatal("early authoritative volume binding is unknown")
	}
	records, err := earlySnapshot()
	_, baseIncomplete := cacheGatePositiveWireSnapshot()
	if err != nil || baseIncomplete || !earlyPending(records, report.Pending) {
		t.Fatal("watcher is not pending before bootstrap:", err)
	}
	earlyRegistry.Lock()
	earlyRegistry.state.UNC = report.UNC
	earlyRegistry.state.Volume = state
	earlyRegistry.Unlock()
	started := parentObservationBoundary()
	earlyRegistry.Lock()
	earlyRegistry.state.Markers.Started = started
	earlyRegistry.Unlock()
	receipt, err := earlyBootstrapRun(t.Context(), report.UNC+`\`)
	earlyRegistry.Lock()
	earlyRegistry.state.Process = &receipt
	if err != nil {
		earlyRegistry.state.Error = err.Error()
	}
	earlyRegistry.Unlock()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal("root capability helper:", err)
	}
	if !receipt.ExitConfirmed || receipt.ExitCode != 0 || receipt.KillRequested || receipt.OwnerRetained || receipt.Native == nil || receipt.Native.Pending || receipt.Native.PinsRetained || !receipt.Native.RootClosed || receipt.Native.CloseError != "" || receipt.Native.ReturnedStatus != 0 || receipt.Native.Flags != 0x406 || receipt.Native.MaximumComponentLength != 255 || receipt.Native.FilesystemName != "remote-fs" {
		t.Fatal("helper did not complete an ordinary successful root query and close")
	}
	settled := parentObservationBoundary()
	admitted := parentObservationBoundary()
	earlyRegistry.Lock()
	earlyRegistry.state.Markers.Settled = settled
	markers := earlyRegistry.state.Markers
	markers.HABegin = admitted
	earlyRegistry.Unlock()
	records, err = earlySnapshot()
	identities, identityErr := preciseIdentitySnapshot()
	_, baseIncomplete = cacheGatePositiveWireSnapshot()
	if err != nil || identityErr != nil || baseIncomplete || !earlyPending(records, report.Pending) {
		t.Fatal("early passive exposure trace or live watcher:", errors.Join(err, identityErr))
	}
	evidence := earlyWireGate(records, identities, report.UNC, state, markers, report.Pending, false)
	if !evidence.Exposed {
		t.Fatal("early capability admission:", evidence.Reason)
	}
}

func earlyMarkHAAPIBegin() {
	sequence := parentObservationBoundary()
	earlyRegistry.Lock()
	defer earlyRegistry.Unlock()
	if earlyRegistry.state.Markers.Settled == 0 || earlyRegistry.state.Markers.HABegin != 0 {
		earlyRegistry.failure = errors.Join(earlyRegistry.failure, errors.New("HA API admission marker lacks unique settled bootstrap"))
		return
	}
	earlyRegistry.state.Markers.HABegin = sequence
}

func earlyCapabilityAudit(t *testing.T, report *parentInvalidationReport) {
	t.Helper()
	records, err := earlySnapshot()
	identities, identityErr := preciseIdentitySnapshot()
	err = errors.Join(err, identityErr, earlyRequestedOnly(identities))
	_, wireIncomplete := cacheGatePositiveWireSnapshot()
	if wireIncomplete {
		err = errors.Join(err, errors.New("parent wire evidence is incomplete"))
	}
	earlyRegistry.Lock()
	state := earlyRegistry.state
	earlyRegistry.Unlock()
	preciseIdentityRegistry.Lock()
	state.Markers.Mutation = preciseIdentityRegistry.mutationSequence
	state.Markers.FirstNewEnd = preciseIdentityRegistry.firstOpenEnd
	preciseIdentityRegistry.Unlock()
	state.Markers.FirstNewBegin = report.FirstObservationSequence
	evidence := earlyWireGate(records, identities, state.UNC, state.Volume, state.Markers, report.Pending, true)
	if state.Error != "" {
		err = errors.Join(err, errors.New(state.Error))
	}
	if state.Process == nil || !state.Process.ExitConfirmed || state.Process.ExitCode != 0 || state.Process.KillRequested || state.Process.OwnerRetained {
		err = errors.Join(err, errors.New("helper process exit was not successfully confirmed"))
	}
	if !evidence.Exposed {
		err = errors.Join(err, errors.New(evidence.Reason))
	}
	if err != nil {
		evidence.Exposed = false
		evidence.Outcome = "inconclusive"
		report.Classification = "inconclusive"
		report.WithinOneSecondProven = false
		t.Error("early capability qualification:", err)
	}
	data, encodeErr := json.MarshalIndent(struct {
		State    earlyBootstrapState
		Wire     []earlyWireRecord
		Identity []preciseIdentityRecord
		Exposure earlyWireEvidence
		Native   precisePolicyEvidence
		Error    string
	}{state, records, identities, evidence, precisePolicyNative(report), fmt.Sprint(err)}, "", "  ")
	if encodeErr == nil {
		encodeErr = os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(os.Getenv("RFS_GATE_OUTPUT_ROOT"), "early-capability.json"), data, 0600)
	}
	if encodeErr != nil {
		t.Error("write early capability evidence:", encodeErr)
	}
}

func TestNativeEarlyCapabilityReplacement(t *testing.T) {
	if os.Getenv("RFS_CAPABILITY_BOOTSTRAP") != "before-ha" || os.Getenv("RFS_PRECISE_VARIANT") != "historical_detail" {
		t.Fatal("early capability cell requires its explicit variant")
	}
	qfid, err := preciseQFidPolicy(os.Getenv("RFS_QFID_POLICY"))
	if err != nil || qfid != preciseRequestedQFid {
		t.Fatal("early capability requires requested-only QFid")
	}
	interaction, err := preciseInteractionPolicy(os.Getenv("RFS_INTERACTION_POLICY"))
	if err != nil || interaction != preciseInteractionStandalone {
		t.Fatal("early capability forbids combined identity policy")
	}
	filesystem, err := preciseFilesystemPolicy(os.Getenv("RFS_FILESYSTEM_CAPABILITY_POLICY"), qfid)
	if err != nil || filesystem != preciseFilesystemPosix {
		t.Fatal("early capability requires its truthful POSIX tuple")
	}
	t.Run("share0_app_first_replace_identity_early_capability", func(t *testing.T) {
		preciseIdentityReset()
		earlyReset()
		earlyActivate()
		t.Cleanup(earlyDeactivate)
		if err := preciseConfigureFilesystemPolicy(filesystem, qfid); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		report := &parentInvalidationReport{Kind: "replacement", Name: "share0_app_first_replace_identity_early_capability", ShareMode: 0, Order: "app_first"}
		parentRunCell(t, report.Name, report.Order, report.ShareMode, true, report)
		if report.RescanRequired || !report.PreciseNotificationProven {
			t.Error("early capability replacement requires precise detailed notification")
		}
	})
}

func earlyTestRecord(sequence, message uint64, command uint16, response bool, name, file string) earlyWireRecord {
	tree := uint32(7)
	return earlyWireRecord{Sequence: sequence, Connection: 1, RawSession: 2, Session: 2, Message: message, RawTree: &tree, Tree: 7, Command: command, Response: response, Name: name, FileID: file, Complete: true}
}

func earlyTestFixture() ([]earlyWireRecord, []preciseIdentityRecord, string, storage.FileVolumeState, earlyMarkers, parentNotifyRequest) {
	unc := `\\127.0.0.1\rfs-test`
	volume := storage.FileVolumeState{VolumeIdentity: "actual-test-volume", RootID: 1, MaxEventBytes: 256 << 10}
	rows := []earlyWireRecord{
		earlyTestRecord(1, 1, wire.TreeConnect, false, unc, ""), earlyTestRecord(2, 1, wire.TreeConnect, true, unc, ""),
		earlyTestRecord(3, 3, wire.Create, false, "v", ""), earlyTestRecord(4, 3, wire.Create, true, "v", "v"),
		earlyTestRecord(5, 5, wire.Create, false, "", ""), earlyTestRecord(6, 5, wire.Create, true, "", "watch"),
		earlyTestRecord(7, 7, wire.ChangeNotify, false, "", "watch"), earlyTestRecord(8, 7, wire.ChangeNotify, true, "", "watch"),
		earlyTestRecord(10, 10, wire.Create, false, "", ""), earlyTestRecord(11, 10, wire.Create, true, "", "helper"),
		earlyTestRecord(12, 12, wire.QueryInfo, false, "", "helper"), earlyTestRecord(13, 12, wire.QueryInfo, true, "", "helper"),
		earlyTestRecord(14, 14, wire.Close, false, "", "helper"), earlyTestRecord(15, 14, wire.Close, true, "", "helper"),
		earlyTestRecord(18, 18, wire.Create, false, `v\target`, ""), earlyTestRecord(19, 18, wire.Create, true, `v\target`, "old"),
		earlyTestRecord(21, 7, wire.ChangeNotify, true, "", "watch"),
		earlyTestRecord(23, 23, wire.Create, false, `v\target`, ""), earlyTestRecord(24, 23, wire.Create, true, `v\target`, "new"),
	}
	zero := uint32(0)
	rows[0].RawTree = &zero
	rows[0].Tree = 0
	async := uint64(0x1122334455667788)
	rows[7].AsyncID = &async
	rows[7].RawTree = nil
	rows[7].Status = 0x103
	rows[16].AsyncID = &async
	rows[16].RawTree = nil
	for _, i := range []int{10, 11} {
		rows[i].QueryType = 2
		rows[i].QueryClass = 5
	}
	rows[11].Attributes, _ = preciseDecodeFilesystemAttributes(preciseTestFilesystemData(0x406))
	identities := []preciseIdentityRecord{{Sequence: 18, Connection: 1, Session: 2, MessageID: 18, Command: wire.Create, ContextsChecked: true, ContextNames: []string{"51466964"}, QFidRequested: true, Complete: true}, {Sequence: 19, Connection: 1, Session: 2, MessageID: 18, Command: wire.Create, Response: true, FileID: "old", ContextsChecked: true, ContextNames: []string{"51466964"}, QFidRequested: true, Complete: true}}
	sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(volume.VolumeIdentity))
	preciseSetQFidTuple(&identities[1], 3, binary.LittleEndian.Uint64(sum[:8]))
	return rows, identities, unc, volume, earlyMarkers{Started: 9, Settled: 16, HABegin: 17, Mutation: 20, FirstNewBegin: 22, FirstNewEnd: 25}, parentNotifyRequest{Key: parentNotifyKey{1, 7}, Session: 2, FileID: "watch", Filter: 31, Recursive: true, Capacity: 65536}
}

func TestEarlyCapabilityWireQualification(t *testing.T) {
	rows, identities, unc, volume, markers, watcher := earlyTestFixture()
	evidence := earlyWireGate(rows, identities, unc, volume, markers, &watcher, true)
	if !evidence.Exposed || !evidence.NoWarming || !evidence.WatcherPending || !evidence.HAProven || !evidence.HnewProven || evidence.Fs5.Sequence >= markers.Settled || markers.HABegin >= evidence.HA.Sequence {
		t.Fatal("truthful early exposure rejected", evidence)
	}
	t.Run("legitimate shared ancestor server open", func(t *testing.T) {
		rows, identities, unc, volume, markers, watcher := earlyTestFixture()
		filtered := make([]earlyWireRecord, 0, len(rows))
		for _, r := range rows {
			if r.Message == 10 || r.Message == 14 {
				continue
			}
			if r.Message == 12 {
				r.FileID = "watch"
			}
			filtered = append(filtered, r)
		}
		result := earlyWireGate(filtered, identities, unc, volume, markers, &watcher, true)
		if !result.Exposed || result.RootCreate.FileID != "watch" {
			t.Fatal("shared legitimate root was rejected", result)
		}
	})
	t.Run("bootstrap preflight does not require an invented future HA", func(t *testing.T) {
		result := earlyWireGate(rows[:14], nil, unc, volume, markers, &watcher, false)
		if !result.Exposed || result.HAProven || result.HnewProven {
			t.Fatal("preflight invented future native ownership", result)
		}
	})
}

func TestEarlyCapabilityWireRefusals(t *testing.T) {
	cases := []struct {
		name   string
		change func(*[]earlyWireRecord, *[]preciseIdentityRecord, *string, *storage.FileVolumeState, *earlyMarkers, *parentNotifyRequest)
	}{
		{"wrong share", func(_ *[]earlyWireRecord, _ *[]preciseIdentityRecord, u *string, _ *storage.FileVolumeState, _ *earlyMarkers, _ *parentNotifyRequest) {
			*u = `\\127.0.0.1\other`
		}},
		{"missing volume", func(_ *[]earlyWireRecord, _ *[]preciseIdentityRecord, _ *string, v *storage.FileVolumeState, _ *earlyMarkers, _ *parentNotifyRequest) {
			v.VolumeIdentity = ""
		}},
		{"wrong actual QFid volume", func(_ *[]earlyWireRecord, i *[]preciseIdentityRecord, _ *string, _ *storage.FileVolumeState, _ *earlyMarkers, _ *parentNotifyRequest) {
			(*i)[1].QFid.VolumeID++
		}},
		{"different helper tree", func(r *[]earlyWireRecord, _ *[]preciseIdentityRecord, _ *string, _ *storage.FileVolumeState, _ *earlyMarkers, _ *parentNotifyRequest) {
			(*r)[11].Tree = 8
		}},
		{"different helper session", func(r *[]earlyWireRecord, _ *[]preciseIdentityRecord, _ *string, _ *storage.FileVolumeState, _ *earlyMarkers, _ *parentNotifyRequest) {
			(*r)[11].Session = 3
		}},
		{"different Hnew tree", func(r *[]earlyWireRecord, _ *[]preciseIdentityRecord, _ *string, _ *storage.FileVolumeState, _ *earlyMarkers, _ *parentNotifyRequest) {
			(*r)[17].Tree = 8
			(*r)[18].Tree = 8
		}},
		{"helper settled after HA API", func(_ *[]earlyWireRecord, _ *[]preciseIdentityRecord, _ *string, _ *storage.FileVolumeState, m *earlyMarkers, _ *parentNotifyRequest) {
			m.Settled = 18
		}},
		{"Fs5 after exit marker", func(_ *[]earlyWireRecord, _ *[]preciseIdentityRecord, _ *string, _ *storage.FileVolumeState, m *earlyMarkers, _ *parentNotifyRequest) {
			m.Settled = 13
		}},
		{"Fs5 before helper invocation", func(_ *[]earlyWireRecord, _ *[]preciseIdentityRecord, _ *string, _ *storage.FileVolumeState, m *earlyMarkers, _ *parentNotifyRequest) {
			m.Started = 13
		}},
		{"Fs5 after HA API marker", func(_ *[]earlyWireRecord, _ *[]preciseIdentityRecord, _ *string, _ *storage.FileVolumeState, m *earlyMarkers, _ *parentNotifyRequest) {
			m.HABegin = 12
		}},
		{"HA CREATE before API marker", func(_ *[]earlyWireRecord, _ *[]preciseIdentityRecord, _ *string, _ *storage.FileVolumeState, m *earlyMarkers, _ *parentNotifyRequest) {
			m.HABegin = 19
		}},
		{"no actual pending watcher", func(r *[]earlyWireRecord, _ *[]preciseIdentityRecord, _ *string, _ *storage.FileVolumeState, _ *earlyMarkers, _ *parentNotifyRequest) {
			(*r)[7].Status = 0
		}},
		{"watcher closed before admission", func(r *[]earlyWireRecord, _ *[]preciseIdentityRecord, _ *string, _ *storage.FileVolumeState, _ *earlyMarkers, _ *parentNotifyRequest) {
			(*r)[12].FileID = "watch"
			(*r)[13].FileID = "watch"
		}},
		{"session retired before admission", func(r *[]earlyWireRecord, _ *[]preciseIdentityRecord, _ *string, _ *storage.FileVolumeState, _ *earlyMarkers, _ *parentNotifyRequest) {
			(*r)[12].Command = wire.Logoff
			(*r)[13].Command = wire.Logoff
		}},
		{"tree disconnected before admission", func(r *[]earlyWireRecord, _ *[]preciseIdentityRecord, _ *string, _ *storage.FileVolumeState, _ *earlyMarkers, _ *parentNotifyRequest) {
			(*r)[12].Command = wire.TreeDisconnect
			(*r)[13].Command = wire.TreeDisconnect
		}},
		{"target warmed by bootstrap CREATE", func(r *[]earlyWireRecord, _ *[]preciseIdentityRecord, _ *string, _ *storage.FileVolumeState, _ *earlyMarkers, _ *parentNotifyRequest) {
			(*r)[8].Name = `v\target`
			(*r)[9].Name = `v\target`
		}},
		{"replacement warmed by bootstrap CREATE", func(r *[]earlyWireRecord, _ *[]preciseIdentityRecord, _ *string, _ *storage.FileVolumeState, _ *earlyMarkers, _ *parentNotifyRequest) {
			(*r)[8].Name = `v\replacement`
			(*r)[9].Name = `v\replacement`
		}},
		{"enumeration before HA", func(r *[]earlyWireRecord, _ *[]preciseIdentityRecord, _ *string, _ *storage.FileVolumeState, _ *earlyMarkers, _ *parentNotifyRequest) {
			(*r)[10].Command = wire.QueryDirectory
			(*r)[11].Command = wire.QueryDirectory
		}},
		{"read before HA", func(r *[]earlyWireRecord, _ *[]preciseIdentityRecord, _ *string, _ *storage.FileVolumeState, _ *earlyMarkers, _ *parentNotifyRequest) {
			(*r)[10].Command = wire.Read
			(*r)[11].Command = wire.Read
		}},
		{"unknown metadata handle", func(r *[]earlyWireRecord, _ *[]preciseIdentityRecord, _ *string, _ *storage.FileVolumeState, _ *earlyMarkers, _ *parentNotifyRequest) {
			(*r)[10].FileID = "unknown"
			(*r)[11].FileID = "unknown"
		}},
		{"Fs5 baseline only", func(r *[]earlyWireRecord, _ *[]preciseIdentityRecord, _ *string, _ *storage.FileVolumeState, _ *earlyMarkers, _ *parentNotifyRequest) {
			(*r)[11].Attributes, _ = preciseDecodeFilesystemAttributes(preciseTestFilesystemData(6))
		}},
		{"Fs5 malformed raw", func(r *[]earlyWireRecord, _ *[]preciseIdentityRecord, _ *string, _ *storage.FileVolumeState, _ *earlyMarkers, _ *parentNotifyRequest) {
			(*r)[11].Attributes.FixedRaw = "bad"
		}},
		{"Fs5 actual failure", func(r *[]earlyWireRecord, _ *[]preciseIdentityRecord, _ *string, _ *storage.FileVolumeState, _ *earlyMarkers, _ *parentNotifyRequest) {
			(*r)[11].Status = 0xc0000022
			(*r)[11].Attributes = nil
		}},
		{"shared server handle for A and B", func(r *[]earlyWireRecord, _ *[]preciseIdentityRecord, _ *string, _ *storage.FileVolumeState, _ *earlyMarkers, _ *parentNotifyRequest) {
			(*r)[18].FileID = "old"
		}},
		{"missing global mutation", func(_ *[]earlyWireRecord, _ *[]preciseIdentityRecord, _ *string, _ *storage.FileVolumeState, m *earlyMarkers, _ *parentNotifyRequest) {
			m.Mutation = 0
		}},
	}
	for _, tc := range cases {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			rows, identity, unc, volume, markers, watcher := earlyTestFixture()
			tc.change(&rows, &identity, &unc, &volume, &markers, &watcher)
			result := earlyWireGate(rows, identity, unc, volume, markers, &watcher, true)
			if result.Exposed || result.Reason == "" {
				t.Fatal("unqualified bootstrap admitted", result)
			}
		})
	}
}

func earlyTestPacket(h wire.Header, body []byte) []byte {
	packet := make([]byte, 64+len(body))
	copy(packet[64:], body)
	if err := h.Encode(packet); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	return packet
}

func earlyTestCorrelated(h wire.Header) cacheGatePositiveWireRecord {
	return cacheGatePositiveWireRecord{Connection: 1, SessionID: h.SessionID, MessageID: h.MessageID, Command: h.Command, Flags: h.Flags, Response: h.Flags&wire.FlagResponse != 0, Status: h.Status}
}

func TestEarlyCapabilityTreeParsing(t *testing.T) {
	t.Run("exact tree path and successful response", func(t *testing.T) {
		earlyReset()
		name := wire.EncodeUTF16(`\\127.0.0.1\rfs-test`)
		body := make([]byte, 8+len(name))
		binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(body, 9)
		binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(body[4:], 72)
		binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(body[6:], uint16(len(name)))
		copy(body[8:], name)
		h := wire.Header{Command: wire.TreeConnect, SessionID: 2, MessageID: 1}
		if !earlyCapture(earlyTestPacket(h, body), earlyTestCorrelated(h)) {
			t.Fatal("TREE_CONNECT request rejected")
		}
		h.Flags = wire.FlagResponse
		h.TreeID = 7
		if !earlyCapture(earlyTestPacket(h, make([]byte, 16)), earlyTestCorrelated(h)) {
			t.Fatal("TREE_CONNECT response rejected")
		}
		rows, err := earlySnapshot()
		if err != nil || len(rows) != 2 || rows[0].Name != `\\127.0.0.1\rfs-test` || rows[0].Tree != 0 || rows[1].Tree != 7 {
			t.Fatal(rows, err)
		}
	})
	t.Run("async response inherits matched request tree", func(t *testing.T) {
		earlyReset()
		body := make([]byte, 32)
		binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(body, 32)
		copy(body[8:24], []byte("watcher-handle-01"))
		h := wire.Header{Command: wire.ChangeNotify, SessionID: 2, TreeID: 7, MessageID: 9}
		if !earlyCapture(earlyTestPacket(h, body), earlyTestCorrelated(h)) {
			t.Fatal("watch request rejected")
		}
		h.Flags = wire.FlagResponse | wire.FlagAsync
		h.Status = 0x103
		h.AsyncID = 0x8877665544332211
		if !earlyCapture(earlyTestPacket(h, make([]byte, 8)), earlyTestCorrelated(h)) {
			t.Fatal("async pending rejected")
		}
		h.Status = 0
		if !earlyCapture(earlyTestPacket(h, make([]byte, 8)), earlyTestCorrelated(h)) {
			t.Fatal("async terminal rejected")
		}
		rows, err := earlySnapshot()
		if err != nil || rows[1].RawTree != nil || rows[2].RawTree != nil || rows[1].Tree != 7 || rows[2].Tree != 7 || *rows[1].AsyncID != h.AsyncID {
			t.Fatal("AsyncId bytes became a tree", rows, err)
		}
	})

	for _, mode := range []string{"missing related predecessor", "async unmatched reply", "async changed identity", "response changed tree", "oversized tree path"} {
		t.Run(mode, func(t *testing.T) {
			earlyReset()
			h := wire.Header{Command: wire.QueryInfo, SessionID: 2, TreeID: 7, MessageID: 10}
			r := earlyTestCorrelated(h)
			r.FileID = "known"
			r.QueryType = 1
			r.QueryClass = 6
			if mode != "missing related predecessor" && mode != "async unmatched reply" && mode != "oversized tree path" {
				if !earlyCapture(earlyTestPacket(h, make([]byte, 8)), r) {
					t.Fatal("setup failed")
				}
			}
			switch mode {
			case "missing related predecessor":
				h.Flags = wire.FlagRelated
				h.SessionID = ^uint64(0)
				h.TreeID = ^uint32(0)

			case "async unmatched reply":
				h.Flags = wire.FlagResponse | wire.FlagAsync
				h.AsyncID = 23
			case "async changed identity":
				h.Flags = wire.FlagResponse | wire.FlagAsync
				h.Status = 0x103
				h.AsyncID = 23
				r = earlyTestCorrelated(h)
				r.FileID = "known"
				r.QueryType = 1
				r.QueryClass = 6
				if !earlyCapture(earlyTestPacket(h, make([]byte, 8)), r) {
					t.Fatal("pending setup failed")
				}
				h.Status = 0
				h.AsyncID++
			case "response changed tree":
				h.Flags = wire.FlagResponse
				h.TreeID = 8
			case "oversized tree path":
				h.Command = wire.TreeConnect
				h.TreeID = 0
			}
			r = earlyTestCorrelated(h)
			r.FileID = "known"
			r.QueryType = 1
			r.QueryClass = 6
			body := make([]byte, 8)
			if mode == "oversized tree path" {
				binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(body, 9)
				binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(body[4:], 72)
				binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(body[6:], earlyWireMaxNameBytes+2)
			}
			if earlyCapture(earlyTestPacket(h, body), r) {
				t.Fatal("invalid tree ownership accepted")
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestEarlyCapabilityNativeFailurePreserved(t *testing.T) {
	rows, identities, unc, volume, markers, watcher := earlyTestFixture()
	rows[18].Status = 0xc0000034
	rows[18].FileID = ""
	result := earlyWireGate(rows, identities, unc, volume, markers, &watcher, true)
	if !result.Exposed || !result.HnewBound || result.HnewProven || result.Hnew == nil || result.Hnew.Status != 0xc0000034 || result.Hnew.FileID != "" {
		t.Fatal("real failed CREATE erased exposure or invented Hnew", result)
	}
}

func TestEarlyCapabilityPassiveBounds(t *testing.T) {
	earlyReset()
	for i := 0; i < earlyWireMaxPending+1; i++ {
		h := wire.Header{Command: wire.QueryInfo, SessionID: 2, TreeID: 7, MessageID: uint64(i + 1)}
		r := earlyTestCorrelated(h)
		r.FileID = "root"
		r.QueryType = 1
		r.QueryClass = 6
		accepted := earlyCapture(earlyTestPacket(h, make([]byte, 8)), r)
		if i < earlyWireMaxPending && !accepted {
			t.Fatal("bounded request refused before limit", i)
		}
		if i == earlyWireMaxPending && accepted {
			t.Fatal("unbounded pending ownership accepted")
		}
	}
	rows, err := earlySnapshot()
	earlyRegistry.Lock()
	pending, retained := len(earlyRegistry.pending), earlyRegistry.bytes
	earlyRegistry.Unlock()
	if err == nil || pending > earlyWireMaxPending || retained > earlyWireMaxBytes || len(rows) > earlyWireMaxRecords {
		t.Fatal("passive bound did not fence admission", pending, retained, len(rows), err)
	}
	earlyReset()
	if earlyCapture([]byte("not a header"), cacheGatePositiveWireRecord{Connection: 1}) {
		t.Fatal("malformed header accepted")
	}
	if _, err := earlySnapshot(); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("malformed header failure disappeared")
	}
}

func TestEarlyCapabilityRequestedOnly(t *testing.T) {
	_, identities, _, _, _, _ := earlyTestFixture()
	if err := earlyRequestedOnly(identities); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	identities[0].QFidRequested = false
	identities[0].ContextNames = nil
	identities[1].QFidRequested = false
	if err := earlyRequestedOnly(identities); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("early cell admitted always-QFid response")
	}
}

func TestEarlyCapabilityTargetWarming(t *testing.T) {
	rows, identity, unc, volume, markers, watcher := earlyTestFixture()
	// The root query stays valid; only an additional target open is introduced.
	rows[12] = earlyTestRecord(14, 14, wire.Create, false, `v\target`, "")
	rows[13] = earlyTestRecord(15, 14, wire.Create, true, `v\target`, "warmed-A")
	result := earlyWireGate(rows, identity, unc, volume, markers, &watcher, true)
	if result.Exposed || result.Reason != "native target CREATE preceded the HA API marker" {
		t.Fatal("bootstrap target warming was not rejected", result)
	}
}

func TestEarlyCapabilityRelatedAsyncOwnership(t *testing.T) {
	earlyReset()
	head := wire.Header{Command: wire.QueryInfo, SessionID: 2, TreeID: 7, MessageID: 10, NextCommand: 72}
	r := earlyTestCorrelated(head)
	r.QueryType = 1
	r.QueryClass = 6
	r.FileID = "known"
	if !earlyCapture(earlyTestPacket(head, make([]byte, 8)), r) {
		t.Fatal("compound head rejected")
	}
	child := wire.Header{Command: wire.QueryInfo, SessionID: 77, TreeID: 88, MessageID: 11, Flags: wire.FlagRelated}
	r = earlyTestCorrelated(child)
	r.QueryType = 1
	r.QueryClass = 6
	r.FileID = "ignored"
	if !earlyCapture(earlyTestPacket(child, make([]byte, 8)), r) {
		t.Fatal("related request rejected")
	}
	head.Flags = wire.FlagResponse
	head.NextCommand = 0
	r = earlyTestCorrelated(head)
	r.QueryType = 1
	r.QueryClass = 6
	r.FileID = "known"
	if !earlyCapture(earlyTestPacket(head, make([]byte, 8)), r) {
		t.Fatal("head result rejected")
	}
	child.Flags = wire.FlagResponse | wire.FlagRelated | wire.FlagAsync
	child.SessionID = 2
	child.AsyncID = 0xaabbccdd11223344
	child.Status = 0x103
	r = earlyTestCorrelated(child)
	r.QueryType = 1
	r.QueryClass = 6
	r.FileID = "known"
	if !earlyCapture(earlyTestPacket(child, make([]byte, 8)), r) {
		t.Fatal("asynchronous related ownership was not inherited from request")
	}
	rows, err := earlySnapshot()
	last := rows[len(rows)-1]
	if err != nil || last.Session != 2 || last.Tree != 7 || last.RawTree != nil || rows[1].RawSession != 77 || rows[1].RawFileID != "ignored" || rows[1].FileID != "known" {
		t.Fatal("async related provenance lost", rows, err)
	}
}

func TestEarlyCapabilityRelatedResults(t *testing.T) {
	for _, raw := range []struct {
		session uint64
		tree    uint32
	}{{77, 88}, {^uint64(0), ^uint32(0)}} {
		t.Run(fmt.Sprint(raw), func(t *testing.T) {
			earlyReset()
			head := wire.Header{Command: wire.QueryInfo, SessionID: 2, TreeID: 7, MessageID: 10, NextCommand: 72}
			r := earlyTestCorrelated(head)
			r.QueryType = 1
			r.QueryClass = 6
			r.FileID = "actual"
			if !earlyCapture(earlyTestPacket(head, make([]byte, 8)), r) {
				t.Fatal("head rejected")
			}
			child := wire.Header{Command: wire.QueryInfo, SessionID: raw.session, TreeID: raw.tree, MessageID: 11, Flags: wire.FlagRelated}
			r = earlyTestCorrelated(child)
			r.QueryType = 1
			r.QueryClass = 6
			r.FileID = "ignored"
			if !earlyCapture(earlyTestPacket(child, make([]byte, 8)), r) {
				t.Fatal("raw ignored request rejected")
			}
			rows, err := earlySnapshot()
			if err == nil || !rows[1].OwnerPending || rows[1].Session != 0 || rows[1].Tree != 0 {
				t.Fatal("unobserved prior result was treated as an owner", rows, err)
			}
			head.Flags = wire.FlagResponse
			head.NextCommand = 0
			r = earlyTestCorrelated(head)
			r.QueryType = 1
			r.QueryClass = 6
			r.FileID = "actual"
			if !earlyCapture(earlyTestPacket(head, make([]byte, 8)), r) {
				t.Fatal("head response rejected")
			}
			rows, err = earlySnapshot()
			if err != nil || rows[1].OwnerPending || rows[1].Session != 2 || rows[1].Tree != 7 || rows[1].FileID != "actual" || rows[1].RawSession != raw.session || *rows[1].RawTree != raw.tree || rows[1].RawFileID != "ignored" {
				t.Fatal("validated predecessor ownership was lost", rows, err)
			}
		})
	}
	for _, mode := range []string{"failed prior result", "foreign prior result", "missing prior result"} {
		t.Run(mode, func(t *testing.T) {
			earlyReset()
			head := wire.Header{Command: wire.QueryInfo, SessionID: 2, TreeID: 7, MessageID: 10, NextCommand: 72}
			r := earlyTestCorrelated(head)
			r.FileID = "actual"
			earlyCapture(earlyTestPacket(head, make([]byte, 8)), r)
			child := wire.Header{Command: wire.QueryInfo, SessionID: 77, TreeID: 88, MessageID: 11, Flags: wire.FlagRelated}
			r = earlyTestCorrelated(child)
			r.FileID = "ignored"
			earlyCapture(earlyTestPacket(child, make([]byte, 8)), r)
			if mode != "missing prior result" {
				head.Flags = wire.FlagResponse
				head.NextCommand = 0
				if mode == "failed prior result" {
					head.Status = 0xc0000022
				} else {
					head.SessionID = 3
				}
				r = earlyTestCorrelated(head)
				r.FileID = "actual"
				if earlyCapture(earlyTestPacket(head, make([]byte, 8)), r) {
					t.Fatal("failed or foreign predecessor qualified")
				}
			}
			if _, err := earlySnapshot(); err == nil {
				t.Fatal("unproven related ownership appeared complete")
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestEarlyCapabilityAsyncTransitionRefusals(t *testing.T) {
	for _, mode := range []string{"synchronous pending", "async final without pending", "synchronous final after async pending", "changed AsyncId"} {
		t.Run(mode, func(t *testing.T) {
			earlyReset()
			body := make([]byte, 32)
			binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(body, 32)
			copy(body[8:24], []byte("watcher-handle-01"))
			header := wire.Header{Command: wire.ChangeNotify, SessionID: 2, TreeID: 7, MessageID: 5}
			if !earlyCapture(earlyTestPacket(header, body), earlyTestCorrelated(header)) {
				t.Fatal("request rejected")
			}
			header.Flags = wire.FlagResponse | wire.FlagAsync
			header.AsyncID = 17
			header.Status = 0x103
			if mode == "synchronous final after async pending" || mode == "changed AsyncId" {
				if !earlyCapture(earlyTestPacket(header, make([]byte, 8)), earlyTestCorrelated(header)) {
					t.Fatal("valid pending rejected")
				}
			}
			switch mode {
			case "synchronous pending":
				header.Flags = wire.FlagResponse
			case "async final without pending":
				header.Status = 0
			case "synchronous final after async pending":
				header.Status = 0
				header.Flags = wire.FlagResponse
			case "changed AsyncId":
				header.Status = 0
				header.AsyncID++
			}
			if earlyCapture(earlyTestPacket(header, make([]byte, 8)), earlyTestCorrelated(header)) {
				t.Fatal("malformed asynchronous ownership qualified")
			}
		})
	}
}

func earlyTestCompound(packets ...[]byte) []byte {
	var frame []byte
	for i, packet := range packets {
		copy := bytes.Clone(packet)
		if i < len(packets)-1 {
			copy = append(copy, make([]byte, (-len(copy))&7)...)
			binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(copy[20:24], uint32(len(copy)))
		} else {
			binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(copy[20:24], 0)
		}
		frame = append(frame, copy...)
	}
	return frame
}

func earlyTestCreatePacket(response bool, message, session uint64, tree uint32, related bool, file []byte) []byte {
	packet := preciseTestCreate(response, nil, nil)
	flags := uint32(0)
	if response {
		flags |= wire.FlagResponse
		copy(packet[128:144], file)
	}
	if related {
		flags |= wire.FlagRelated
	}
	if err := (wire.Header{Command: wire.Create, MessageID: message, SessionID: session, TreeID: tree, Flags: flags}).Encode(packet); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	return packet
}

func earlyTestQueryPacket(response bool, message, session uint64, tree uint32, related bool, file []byte) []byte {
	var packet []byte
	if response {
		packet = preciseTestQuery(make([]byte, 8))
	} else {
		packet = make([]byte, 104)
		binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(packet[64:], 41)
		packet[66] = 1
		packet[67] = 6
		binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(packet[68:], 8)
		copy(packet[88:104], file)
	}
	flags := uint32(0)
	if response {
		flags |= wire.FlagResponse
	}
	if related {
		flags |= wire.FlagRelated
	}
	if err := (wire.Header{Command: wire.QueryInfo, MessageID: message, SessionID: session, TreeID: tree, Flags: flags}).Encode(packet); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	return packet
}

func earlyTestObserver(t *testing.T) *cacheGatePositiveFrameObserver {
	preciseIdentityReset()
	earlyReset()
	cacheGateResetPositiveWire()
	parentNotifyReset()
	earlyActivate()
	t.Cleanup(earlyDeactivate)
	return cacheGateNewPositiveFrameObserver()
}

func TestEarlyCapabilityGeneratedRelatedFrames(t *testing.T) {
	actual := bytes.Repeat([]byte{0x17}, 16)
	for _, mode := range []string{"arbitrary ignored IDs", "all-ones IDs", "failed prior TREE_CONNECT", "foreign prior result", "missing prior result"} {
		t.Run(mode, func(t *testing.T) {
			observer := earlyTestObserver(t)
			name := wire.EncodeUTF16(`\\127.0.0.1\rfs-test`)
			body := make([]byte, 8+len(name))
			binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(body, 9)
			binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(body[4:], 72)
			binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(body[6:], uint16(len(name)))
			copy(body[8:], name)
			connect := earlyTestPacket(wire.Header{Command: wire.TreeConnect, SessionID: 2, MessageID: 1}, body)
			rawSession, rawTree := uint64(77), uint32(88)
			ignored := bytes.Repeat([]byte{0x55}, 16)
			if mode == "all-ones IDs" {
				rawSession = ^uint64(0)
				rawTree = ^uint32(0)
				ignored = bytes.Repeat([]byte{0xff}, 16)
			}
			request := earlyTestCompound(connect, earlyTestCreatePacket(false, 2, rawSession, rawTree, true, nil), earlyTestQueryPacket(false, 3, rawSession, rawTree, true, ignored))
			original := bytes.Clone(request)
			observer.frame(request, false)
			rows, err := earlySnapshot()
			if observer.incomplete || err == nil || len(rows) != 3 || !rows[1].OwnerPending || rows[1].Tree != 0 || !bytes.Equal(request, original) {
				t.Fatal("unresolved request allocation was rejected or invented", rows, err)
			}
			if mode == "missing prior result" {
				return
			}
			sid, tree, status := uint64(2), uint32(7), uint32(0)
			responseBody := wire.TreeConnectResponseBody(1, 0, 0, 0)
			if mode == "failed prior TREE_CONNECT" {
				status = 0xc0000022
				tree = 0
				responseBody = wire.ErrorResponseBody()
			}
			if mode == "foreign prior result" {
				sid = 3
			}
			connected := earlyTestPacket(wire.Header{Command: wire.TreeConnect, SessionID: sid, TreeID: tree, MessageID: 1, Flags: wire.FlagResponse, Status: status}, responseBody)
			response := earlyTestCompound(connected, earlyTestCreatePacket(true, 2, 2, 7, true, actual), earlyTestQueryPacket(true, 3, 2, 7, true, nil))
			responseOriginal := bytes.Clone(response)
			observer.frame(response, true)
			rows, err = earlySnapshot()
			identities, identityErr := preciseIdentitySnapshot()
			if mode == "failed prior TREE_CONNECT" || mode == "foreign prior result" {
				if !observer.incomplete || err == nil {
					t.Fatal("failed/foreign allocation qualified", rows, err)
				}
				return
			}
			if observer.incomplete || err != nil || identityErr != nil || len(identities) != 4 || len(rows) != 6 || rows[1].OwnerPending || rows[1].Tree != 7 || rows[1].Session != 2 || rows[1].RawSession != rawSession || *rows[1].RawTree != rawTree || rows[2].RawFileID != hex.EncodeToString(ignored) || rows[2].FileID != hex.EncodeToString(actual) || !bytes.Equal(response, responseOriginal) {
				t.Fatal("full parser failed actual related allocation", rows, err, identities, identityErr)
			}
			if identities[0].RawSession != rawSession || identities[0].Session != 2 || identities[1].FileID != hex.EncodeToString(actual) {
				t.Fatal("private identity view lost raw/effective ownership", identities)
			}
			for _, record := range observer.records {
				if record.MessageID == 3 && (record.SessionID != 2 || record.FileID != hex.EncodeToString(actual)) {
					t.Fatal("base coldness view retained ignored raw ownership", record)
				}
			}
		})
	}
	t.Run("related existing-open READ to QUERY_INFO", func(t *testing.T) {
		observer := earlyTestObserver(t)
		observer.frame(earlyTestCreatePacket(false, 1, 2, 7, false, nil), false)
		observer.frame(earlyTestCreatePacket(true, 1, 2, 7, false, actual), true)
		body := make([]byte, 48)
		binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(body, 49)
		binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(body[4:], 1)
		copy(body[16:32], actual)
		head := earlyTestPacket(wire.Header{Command: wire.Read, SessionID: 2, TreeID: 7, MessageID: 2}, body)
		ignored := bytes.Repeat([]byte{0xff}, 16)
		request := earlyTestCompound(head, earlyTestQueryPacket(false, 3, 77, 88, true, ignored))
		before := bytes.Clone(request)
		observer.frame(request, false)
		responseBody := make([]byte, 16)
		binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(responseBody, 17)
		read := earlyTestPacket(wire.Header{Command: wire.Read, SessionID: 2, TreeID: 7, MessageID: 2, Flags: wire.FlagResponse}, responseBody)
		observer.frame(earlyTestCompound(read, earlyTestQueryPacket(true, 3, 2, 7, true, nil)), true)
		rows, err := earlySnapshot()
		identities, identityErr := preciseIdentitySnapshot()
		if observer.incomplete || err != nil || identityErr != nil || !bytes.Equal(request, before) {
			t.Fatal("existing-open related chain rejected", rows, err, identities, identityErr)
		}
		if identities[len(identities)-2].RawSession != 77 || identities[len(identities)-2].Session != 2 || identities[len(identities)-2].FileID != hex.EncodeToString(actual) {
			t.Fatal("existing-open identity owner was guessed", identities)
		}
	})
	t.Run("related CREATE to NOTIFY pending", func(t *testing.T) {
		observer := earlyTestObserver(t)
		body := make([]byte, 32)
		binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(body, 32)
		binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(body[2:], 1)
		binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(body[4:], 65536)
		copy(body[8:24], bytes.Repeat([]byte{0xff}, 16))
		binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(body[24:], 31)
		notify := earlyTestPacket(wire.Header{Command: wire.ChangeNotify, SessionID: 77, TreeID: 88, MessageID: 2, Flags: wire.FlagRelated}, body)
		observer.frame(earlyTestCompound(earlyTestCreatePacket(false, 1, 2, 7, false, nil), notify), false)
		observer.frame(earlyTestCreatePacket(true, 1, 2, 7, false, actual), true)
		pending := earlyTestPacket(wire.Header{Command: wire.ChangeNotify, SessionID: 2, MessageID: 2, Flags: wire.FlagResponse | wire.FlagAsync, AsyncID: 91, Status: 0x103}, wire.ErrorResponseBody())
		observer.frame(pending, true)
		rows, err := earlySnapshot()
		requests, _, bad := parentNotifySnapshot()
		if observer.incomplete || err != nil || bad || len(requests) != 1 || requests[0].Session != 2 || requests[0].FileID != hex.EncodeToString(actual) || rows[len(rows)-1].Tree != 7 || rows[len(rows)-1].RawTree != nil {
			t.Fatal("related notification hook kept unresolved ownership", rows, err, requests, bad)
		}
	})
}

func TestEarlyCapabilityGeneratedAsyncFrames(t *testing.T) {
	actual := bytes.Repeat([]byte{0x17}, 16)
	for _, mode := range []string{"valid pending and terminal", "sync pending", "async terminal without pending", "sync terminal after pending", "changed AsyncId"} {
		t.Run(mode, func(t *testing.T) {
			observer := earlyTestObserver(t)
			observer.frame(earlyTestCreatePacket(false, 1, 2, 7, false, nil), false)
			observer.frame(earlyTestCreatePacket(true, 1, 2, 7, false, actual), true)
			body := make([]byte, 32)
			binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(body, 32)
			binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(body[2:], 1)
			binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(body[4:], 65536)
			copy(body[8:24], actual)
			binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(body[24:], 31)
			observer.frame(earlyTestPacket(wire.Header{Command: wire.ChangeNotify, SessionID: 2, TreeID: 7, MessageID: 2}, body), false)
			pendingHeader := wire.Header{Command: wire.ChangeNotify, SessionID: 2, TreeID: 7, MessageID: 2, Flags: wire.FlagResponse | wire.FlagAsync, AsyncID: 91, Status: 0x103}
			if mode == "sync pending" {
				pendingHeader.Flags = wire.FlagResponse
			}
			if mode != "async terminal without pending" {
				observer.frame(earlyTestPacket(pendingHeader, wire.ErrorResponseBody()), true)
			}
			if mode != "sync pending" {
				data := parentTestNotifyBuffer(parentNotifyItem{Action: 3, Name: `v\target`})
				terminalBody := make([]byte, 8+len(data))
				binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(terminalBody, 9)
				binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(terminalBody[2:], 72)
				binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(terminalBody[4:], uint32(len(data)))
				copy(terminalBody[8:], data)
				terminal := pendingHeader
				terminal.Status = 0
				if mode == "sync terminal after pending" {
					terminal.Flags = wire.FlagResponse
				}
				if mode == "changed AsyncId" {
					terminal.AsyncID++
				}
				observer.frame(earlyTestPacket(terminal, terminalBody), true)
			}
			rows, err := earlySnapshot()
			if mode == "valid pending and terminal" {
				_, results, bad := parentNotifySnapshot()
				if observer.incomplete || err != nil || bad || len(results) != 1 || results[0].Request.Session != 2 || results[0].Request.FileID != hex.EncodeToString(actual) || rows[len(rows)-1].RawTree != nil || rows[len(rows)-1].Tree != 7 {
					t.Fatal("actual async frame path lost ownership", rows, err, results, bad)
				}
			} else if !observer.incomplete || err == nil {
				t.Fatal("malformed actual async frame path qualified", mode, rows, err)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestEarlyCapabilitySessionAllocation(t *testing.T) {
	cases := []struct {
		name              string
		request, response uint64
		status            uint32
		accepted          bool
	}{
		{"initial allocation", 0, 2, 0, true}, {"initial challenge allocation", 0, 2, 0xc0000016, true},
		{"missing successful allocation", 0, 0, 0, false}, {"missing challenge allocation", 0, 0, 0xc0000016, false},
		{"initial error without allocation", 0, 0, 0xc000006d, true}, {"initial error with allocation", 0, 2, 0xc000006d, true},
		{"same continuation", 2, 2, 0, true}, {"foreign continuation success", 2, 3, 0, false},
		{"foreign continuation challenge", 2, 3, 0xc0000016, false}, {"foreign continuation error", 2, 3, 0xc000006d, false},
	}
	for _, tc := range cases {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			earlyReset()
			request := wire.Header{Command: wire.SessionSetup, SessionID: tc.request, MessageID: 1}
			if !earlyCapture(earlyTestPacket(request, make([]byte, 24)), earlyTestCorrelated(request)) {
				t.Fatal("request rejected")
			}
			response := wire.Header{Command: wire.SessionSetup, SessionID: tc.response, MessageID: 1, Flags: wire.FlagResponse, Status: tc.status}
			if got := earlyCapture(earlyTestPacket(response, make([]byte, 8)), earlyTestCorrelated(response)); got != tc.accepted {
				t.Fatal("session allocation qualification", got, tc)
			}
		})
	}
	t.Run("foreign continuation cannot seed a related TREE_CONNECT", func(t *testing.T) {
		observer := earlyTestObserver(t)
		setup := make([]byte, 24)
		binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(setup, 25)
		head := earlyTestPacket(wire.Header{Command: wire.SessionSetup, SessionID: 2, MessageID: 1}, setup)
		name := wire.EncodeUTF16(`\\127.0.0.1\rfs-test`)
		body := make([]byte, 8+len(name))
		binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(body, 9)
		binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(body[4:], 72)
		binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(body[6:], uint16(len(name)))
		copy(body[8:], name)
		connect := earlyTestPacket(wire.Header{Command: wire.TreeConnect, SessionID: 77, TreeID: 88, MessageID: 2, Flags: wire.FlagRelated}, body)
		request := earlyTestCompound(head, connect)
		before := bytes.Clone(request)
		observer.frame(request, false)
		responseBody := make([]byte, 8)
		binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(responseBody, 9)
		response := earlyTestPacket(wire.Header{Command: wire.SessionSetup, SessionID: 3, MessageID: 1, Flags: wire.FlagResponse}, responseBody)
		observer.frame(response, true)
		rows, err := earlySnapshot()
		if !observer.incomplete || err == nil || !rows[1].OwnerPending || !bytes.Equal(request, before) {
			t.Fatal("foreign allocation seeded related ownership", rows, err)
		}
	})
}
